meta.description: What this site collects when you visit it, and why.

entete.titre: This site collects as little as possible.
entete.accroche: This page states exactly what this site keeps from your visit.

sections.titre: What this site does not do
paragraphes: This site has no form: it does not ask for your name, address or message.
It sets no cookies and stores nothing on your device.
It does not measure traffic: no tool counts your visits.
It loads nothing from another site: fonts, images, videos and scripts come from this site.
Like any web server, this site's server records each request in a technical log: the IP address, the date and time, the page requested, the page you came from and the type of browser.
This log is used only for the site's security and proper operation: spotting an attack, fixing an error.
It is not sold, nor used to track your visits. It stays on the site's server.
It is deleted automatically after 30 days at most.

sections.titre: Who is responsible, and your requests
paragraphes: The person responsible for this log is the site's publisher (see the {mentionsLegales}).
You can ask to see or delete what concerns you by writing to {email}. To find your visit, we will need your IP address and the approximate time.

sections.titre: What this page does not cover, and its changes
paragraphes: This page covers this site only. It does not describe the Planner application, nor the data schools manage in it.
If this site ever collects anything else, for example through a contact form, this page will be updated first.
